{{Navbar-GlobalBioenergyPowerTracker}}
'''Eneco Bio Golden Raand power station''' is an operating power station of at least 49-megawatts (MW) in Groningen, Netherlands.
It is also known as Bio Golden Raand Biomassa Cogen Plant.
